browser.notice.kept: This file changed on disk, and the snippet you had selected was found again.
browser.notice.differentMatch: This file changed on disk, and what is now in that position is a different snippet, so the selection was cleared.
browser.notice.gone: This file changed on disk and no longer holds the snippet that was selected, so the selection was cleared.
browser.notice.unresolved: This file changed on disk and could not be read again, so the selection was cleared.
browser.notice.deleted: That snippet was deleted. This window has read the file again and selected whatever now sits where it was; if the file holds no snippets any more, nothing is selected.
browser.rawSave.replacesWholeDocument: Saving writes this file's whole text exactly as it appears here. This is not an edit to one snippet: the entire document is replaced.
browser.rawSave.willNotLoad: espanso will not load this file until this is fixed.
browser.rawSave.stoppedAt: The YAML reader stopped at line {line}, column {column}.
browser.rawSave.positionUnknown: The YAML reader did not say where it stopped.
browser.saveOutcome.fileWritten: The file was written. What is on disk now is exactly the text that was sent.
browser.saveOutcome.nothingToWrite: The text was already exactly what the file held, so nothing was written. Both checks still ran; this is a save with nothing to do.
browser.saveOutcome.backupTaken: A copy of this file as it was before this session's first change to it was kept. Only the last ten sessions of copies are kept, so this is not a promise that the file can be recovered later.
browser.saveOutcome.nothingWasWritten: Nothing was written. The file on disk is exactly as it was.
browser.saveOutcome.changedElsewhere: This file changed after its text was loaded here, so the save was refused rather than applied over that change.
browser.saveOutcome.draftKeptInMemory: Your text is still here, exactly as you wrote it. Nothing has been discarded and nothing has been reloaded.
browser.saveOutcome.reloadDiscardsDraft: Loading the version on disk replaces your text with it, and your text cannot be brought back afterwards. Copy it first if you want to keep it.
browser.saveOutcome.changedAgainSinceRef: The file changed again after the save was refused, so the version read afterwards is not the one that refused it.
browser.saveOutcome.windowOutOfStep: The file was written. This window could not read it back afterwards, so what it shows of this file is incomplete rather than wrong.
browser.saveOutcome.choice.confirmReload: Discard my text and load it

browser.rawEditor.sendFailed: The save could not be sent, so nothing was written. Your text is still here.
browser.rawEditor.mayHaveWritten: The save did not finish, and this app cannot tell whether the file was written. What is on disk may be the text below, or may be what was there before. Your text is still here; look at the file before saving again.
browser.rawEditor.savingCannotBeStopped: This save cannot be stopped, so the editor stays open until it answers.
browser.rawEditor.findingsAreStale: These findings are about the text as it was when it was sent, and you have changed it since. Save again to have the text as it is now checked.

browser.rawEditor.draftCopied: Your text was copied to the clipboard.
browser.rawEditor.draftCopyFailed: Your text could not be copied to the clipboard. It is still in the box above, so it can be selected and copied by hand.
browser.rawEditor.diskVersionUnavailable: The version on disk cannot be read here, so it cannot be loaded in place of your text.
browser.rawEditor.revisionExpected: Your text was loaded from version {revision}.
browser.rawEditor.revisionFound: The file held version {revision} when the save was refused.
browser.rawEditor.revisionDisk: The version read from disk afterwards is {revision}.
browser.rawEditor.readOnlyFile: This file is read-only, so this app will not write to it.
browser.rawEditor.notProjected: This file could not be read, so its text cannot be edited here.
browser.rawEditor.lineEndingsNotPreserve: This file uses carriage returns in its line endings, and this editor cannot give them back exactly as they are. Rather than rewrite every line ending in the file without being asked, it will not open this file for editing.
browser.matchEditor.readOnly.notDecodabl: This app could not read this value back as plain text, so what is shown is the file's own characters rather than the value itself. Editing it here could not be given back unchanged, so this field is shown and not edited.
browser.matchEditor.readOnly.carriageRet: This value contains a carriage return, and a text box in this window turns every carriage return into a line break. Rather than change a character you did not touch, this field is shown and not edited.
browser.matchEditor.readOnly.ownsNoBytes: This key is in the file with nothing after it, so there is no value here to replace. Writing one has to be done in the file itself for now, so this field is shown and not edited.
browser.matchEditor.readOnly.unmodelledS: This file writes this key as something other than a single piece of text, so this app cannot edit it as one and will not write over it. This field is shown and not edited.
browser.matchEditor.readOnly.triggerNotS: This snippet does not fire from one literal trigger, so its trigger is shown and not edited here. Changing a snippet from one trigger form to another is not something this app does.

browser.matchEditor.savingCannotBeStoppe: This save cannot be stopped, so the editor stays open until it answers.
browser.matchEditor.discardWarning: Leaving the editor discards the changes in these boxes, and they cannot be brought back afterwards.
browser.matchEditor.sendFailed: The save could not be sent, so nothing was written. What you typed is still here.
browser.matchEditor.mayHaveWritten: The save did not finish, and this app cannot tell whether the file was written. What is on disk may be what you typed, or may be what was there before. What you typed is still here; look at the file before saving again.
browser.matchEditor.findingsAreStale: These findings are about the snippet as it was when it was sent, and you have changed it since. Save again to have it checked as it is now.
browser.matchEditor.notes: What this save had to change in the way the file is written:
browser.matchEditor.revisionExpected: This snippet was loaded from version {revision}.
browser.matchEditor.revisionFound: The file held version {revision} when the save was refused.
browser.matchEditor.revisionDisk: The version read from disk afterwards is {revision}.
browser.matchEditor.identityStale: The file was written, and this window can no longer point at this snippet inside it. Nothing you typed is lost, and saving again is not offered: read the file again and open the snippet from there.
browser.matchEditor.needsReprojection: This snippet has been written. Reading it again is what tells this app how the file now spells each value, and which fields it may edit.
browser.matchEditor.cannotReproject.notP: This window does not hold a fresh reading of this snippet, so it cannot read it again here. Stop editing, open the file again, and pick the snippet from there.
browser.matchEditor.cannotReproject.othe: This window has moved to another file, so it cannot read this snippet again. Stop editing, open the file again, and pick the snippet from there.
This window has moved to another snippet in this file, so it cannot read this one again. Stop editing, then pick this snippet again from the list.
browser.matchEditor.shapeOnly: This value is not one piece of text, so what is named here is its shape and not the characters the file holds.
browser.matchEditor.fieldAbsent: This key is not in the file. Leaving this box empty writes nothing; typing in it adds the key.
browser.matchEditor.fieldRemoved: This key will be taken out of the file when you save.

browser.matchCreation.lineEndings.trigge: This box holds one line. A carriage return pasted into it is removed rather than turned into a line break, so the text that fires the snippet is what is left once it has been taken out.
browser.matchCreation.lineEndings.replac: A line break in this box is written as a line feed. A carriage return cannot be typed here, and one that is pasted in becomes an ordinary line break.
browser.matchCreation.savingCannotBeStop: This save cannot be stopped, so this form stays open until it answers.
browser.matchCreation.discardWarning: Leaving discards what is in these boxes, and it cannot be brought back afterwards.
browser.matchCreation.sendFailed: This snippet could not be sent, so nothing was written. What you typed is still here.
browser.matchCreation.mayHaveWritten: The save did not finish, and this app cannot tell whether the file was written. The snippet may already be in the file, or may not. What you typed is still here; look at the file before adding it again.
browser.matchCreation.findingsAreStale: These findings are about the snippet as it was when it was sent, and you have changed it since. Add it again to have it checked as it is now.
browser.matchCreation.notes: What this save had to change in the way the file is written:
browser.matchCreation.revisionExpected: This snippet was written against version {revision}.
browser.matchCreation.revisionFound: The file held version {revision} when the save was refused.
browser.matchCreation.revisionDisk: The version read from disk afterwards is {revision}.
browser.matchCreation.committed: This snippet is in the file. The files this form was offering have been written to since it opened, so adding another one starts from a fresh reading of them.
browser.matchCreation.createdNotIdentifi: The file changed again between the write and the reading that followed it, so this window cannot point at the snippet it has just added. It is in the file; find it in the list.
browser.matchCreation.destination.notASn: espanso does not load snippets out of this file, so a snippet written here would never fire. Choose a snippet file instead.
browser.matchCreation.destination.readOn: This app must not write to this file, so it cannot add a snippet to it.
browser.matchCreation.destination.couldN: This app could not read this file, so it does not know what is in it or where a snippet would go. The file list says why it could not be read.
browser.matchCreation.destination.notPar: This file could not be read as YAML, so this app does not know where a snippet would go in it. Repair the file first.
browser.matchCreation.destination.noMatc: This file has no snippet list to add to. Add a “matches:” list to it in the file itself, and it can be chosen here afterwards.
browser.matchCreation.cannotCreate.alrea: This snippet has been written to the file. Reading the file again is what tells this app what it now holds, so close this form and open a new one to add another.
browser.matchCreation.cannotCreate.saveI: This snippet is being written, so nothing can be changed until the file answers.
browser.matchCreation.cannotCreate.confl: The file changed while this snippet was being written, so nothing was written. Read what happened before adding it again.
browser.matchCreation.cannotCreate.noDes: Choose the file this snippet should be added to.
browser.matchCreation.cannotCreate.desti: This app cannot add a snippet to the file chosen. Choose another one.
browser.matchCreation.cannotCreate.ancho: The snippet this new one was to follow is no longer in the file chosen, so choose where it goes again.
browser.matchCreation.cannotCreate.trigg: A snippet needs the text that fires it.
browser.matchCreation.cannotCreate.repla: A snippet needs something to expand to.
browser.matchCreation.cannotCreate.carri: One of these values contains a carriage return, which no box in this window could show you back afterwards, so it will not be written.
browser.matchDeletion.label: Deleting a snippet
browser.matchDeletion.question: Delete this snippet from the file? It is written to disk straight away, and this app cannot bring it back afterwards.
browser.matchDeletion.deletingCannotBeSt: This deletion cannot be stopped, so this stays open until the file answers.
browser.matchDeletion.confirmationRefuse: This window has read the file again since you were asked, so this reading of the snippet no longer stands and nothing has been deleted. Leave this, pick the snippet in the list again, and delete it from there.
browser.matchDeletion.sendFailed: The deletion could not be sent, so nothing was written. The snippet is still in the file.
browser.matchDeletion.mayHaveWritten: The save did not finish, and this app cannot tell whether the file was written. The snippet may already be gone from the file, or may not. Look at the file before deleting it again.
browser.matchDeletion.findingsAreStale: These findings are about a reading of the file that no longer stands. Ask to delete this snippet again to have it checked as the file is now.
browser.matchDeletion.notes: What this save had to change in the way the file is written:
browser.matchDeletion.revisionExpected: This snippet was read from version {revision}.
browser.matchDeletion.revisionFound: The file held version {revision} when the save was refused.
browser.matchDeletion.revisionDisk: The version read from disk afterwards is {revision}.
browser.matchDeletion.spent: This snippet has been deleted. Nothing more can be deleted from here: pick another snippet in the list first.
browser.matchDeletion.refused.readOnly: This app must not write to this file, so it cannot delete anything from it.
browser.matchDeletion.refused.lastSnippe: This is the only snippet in this file, and emptying a file’s snippet list is not something this app does. Delete the file itself instead, outside this app.
browser.matchDeletion.refused.notInDocum: This snippet and the reading of the file this window holds do not go together, so nothing can be deleted from here. Read the file again and pick the snippet from the list.

ipc.unexpectedFailure: Something went wrong that this app does not recognise. The technical details are in the developer console.
code.diagnosticCode.parseFailed: espansoConfig’s YAML parser could not read this file. Reading stopped at line {line}, column {column}.
code.diagnosticCode.indexRejected: This file could not be indexed. That is a fault in espansoConfig rather than a problem with the file.
code.diagnosticCode.noDocument: This file holds no document: it is empty, or it holds only comments.
code.diagnosticCode.emptyDocument: Document {document} of this file has no content.
code.diagnosticCode.additionalDocumentNo: Document {document} was not interpreted, because espanso reads only the first document of a file.
code.diagnosticCode.rootIsNotAMapping: The top level of this file is {found} rather than a set of keys, so it holds no espanso settings.
code.diagnosticCode.fieldHasUnexpectedSh: The key “{key}” holds {found}, which is not the shape espansoConfig’s model allows there.
code.diagnosticCode.repeatedKey: The key “{key}” appears more than once in the same block.
code.diagnosticCode.nonScalarKey: One key of this file is not a plain name, so nothing can address the entry it opens.
code.diagnosticCode.shapeDisagreesWithLo: The folder this file is in and its content disagree: the content looks like {shape}.
code.diagnosticCode.matchHasNoTrigger: This snippet has no trigger. It needs one of trigger, triggers or regex.
code.diagnosticCode.matchHasSeveralTrigg: This snippet declares {count} trigger forms, and espansoConfig’s model allows exactly one.
code.diagnosticCode.matchHasNoContent: This snippet has nothing to insert. It needs one of replace, form, markdown, html or image_path.
code.diagnosticCode.matchHasSeveralConte: This snippet declares {count} content fields, and espansoConfig’s model allows exactly one.
code.diagnosticCode.matchIsNotAMapping: This entry of the snippet list is {found} rather than a set of keys, so it is not a snippet.
code.diagnosticCode.variableIsNotAMappin: This entry of the variable list is {found} rather than a set of keys, so it is not a variable.
code.diagnosticCode.variableHasNoName: This variable has no name, so no template can refer to it.
code.diagnosticCode.variableHasNoType: This variable has no type, so espanso cannot decide how to evaluate it.
code.diagnosticCode.scalarNotDecodable: One value of this file could not be decoded, so its source text is shown instead.
code.diagnosticCode.valueTooDeep: A value of this file nests past {depth} levels, and is shown without being read any deeper.
code.diagnosticCode.coverageIsIncomplete: espansoConfig did not account for every entry of one block. That is a fault in this app, and nothing in the file was changed.
code.diagnosticCode.keyNotAccountedFor: espansoConfig neither read nor recorded one key of this file. That is a fault in this app, and nothing in the file was changed.
code.diagnosticCode.hazard: This file contains {kind}, which the visual editor cannot change without risking the rest of the file.
code.unknownReason.notModelled: espansoConfig has no field for this key, so the entry was recorded and is kept exactly as the file writes it.
code.unknownReason.unexpectedShape: This key holds {found}, which is not the shape espansoConfig models, so the entry was recorded and is kept exactly as the file writes it.
code.unknownReason.repeatedKey: An earlier entry of this block already used this key, so this one was recorded and is kept exactly as the file writes it.
code.unknownReason.nonScalarKey: This key is not a plain name, so nothing can address it. The entry was recorded and is kept exactly as the file writes it.
code.hazardKind.commentInFlowCollection: a comment inside an inline list or map
code.hazardKind.explicitKeyMapping: a block written in the explicit “? key” form
code.hazardKind.truncatedBlockScalarHead: a text block whose header is incomplete
code.hazardKind.unclassifiedTrivia: bytes this app could not classify
code.hazardKind.duplicateMappingKey: a key that appears twice in one block
code.hazardKind.multiDocumentStream: several YAML documents in one file
code.valueKind.other: something this app does not model
code.documentShape.other: neither a snippet file nor a configuration profile
code.commandError.noWorkspaceOpen: No espanso configuration is open yet.
code.commandError.configDirNotFound: No espanso configuration folder was found in any of the places this app looks.
code.commandError.io: The file {path} could not be read.
code.commandError.notUtf8: The file {path} is not valid UTF-8 text. The first byte that is not is at offset {offset}.
code.commandError.unknownDocument: This window has no file open with that identifier.
code.commandError.identityWrongDocument: That snippet belongs to a different file from the one it was looked for in.
code.commandError.identityStaleRevision: This file has changed since that snippet was selected, so the selection has to be resolved again.
code.commandError.identityNoSuchMatch: This file no longer holds that snippet.
code.commandError.menuUnavailable: The application menu could not be updated in the language you chose.
code.commandError.invalidMenuLabels: The application menu could not be updated, because this window and the application disagree about which menu labels it needs.
code.commandError.menuBuildFailed: The application menu could not be rebuilt, so it is still showing the language it had.
code.commandError.moveNotWithinOneSequen: espansoConfig could not establish that the snippet you chose is an item of this file's snippet list, so it has no place in that list to work from.
code.commandError.documentHasNoMatchList: This file has no snippet list, so a new snippet cannot be added to it. Add a `matches:` line to the file first, or choose another file.
code.commandError.draftRefused: espansoConfig did not attempt this save at all: the changes asked for cannot be written to this snippet. What it reports beside this is the reason.
code.commandError.saveFailed: espansoConfig could not carry this save through. What it reports beside this is the reason.
code.workspaceError.discovery: The espanso configuration folder could not be opened.
code.workspaceError.unknownDocument: This window has no file open with that identifier.
code.workspaceError.identity: That snippet could not be found again.
code.workspaceError.io: The file {path} could not be read.
code.workspaceError.notUtf8: The file {path} is not valid UTF-8 text. The first byte that is not is at offset {offset}.
code.discoveryError.configDirNotFound: No espanso configuration folder was found in any of the places this app looks.
code.discoveryError.io: The folder {path} could not be read.
code.identityError.wrongDocument: That snippet belongs to a different file from the one it was looked for in.
code.identityError.staleRevision: This file has changed since that snippet was selected, so the selection has to be resolved again.
code.identityError.noSuchMatch: This file no longer holds that snippet.
code.triggerKind.several: Several kinds of trigger at once
code.contentKind.several: Several kinds of content at once
code.variableKind.unrecognised: Type this app does not recognise
code.saveVerdict.proceed: Nothing found in the result prevents espansoConfig from saving it.
code.saveVerdict.refusedForEditorModelEr: The result contradicts the shape espansoConfig models for a snippet, so it was not saved.
code.saveVerdict.refusedForUnacknowledge: The result contains something that looks wrong. Saving it needs your confirmation first.
code.saveError.documentIsReadOnly: {path} belongs to an installed package, so espansoConfig does not write it.
code.saveError.replacementRequiresBackup: Replacing the whole text of {path} needs a copy of what the file holds now, and this save was set up without one, so the file was left as it was.
code.saveError.target: espansoConfig could not reach the file it was asked to save, so the file was left as it was.
code.saveError.targetNotUtf8: {path} is not valid UTF-8 at byte {offset}, so espansoConfig cannot edit it as text.
code.saveError.revisionMismatch: {path} changed after espansoConfig read it, so the save stopped. Reload the file and make the change again.
code.saveError.patch: The change could not be applied to the file’s text, so the file was left as it was.
code.saveError.candidateParseDisagrees: Two readings of the same result disagreed with each other. That is a fault in this app, and the file was left as it was.
code.saveError.refused: The result was not saved, because espansoConfig found something in it worth showing you first.
code.saveError.backup: The copy espansoConfig takes before its first change to a file could not be created, so the file was left as it was.
code.saveError.write: The file could not be replaced. Reload it to see what it holds now.
code.writeError.targetMissing: There is no file at {path} to replace, and espansoConfig replaces files rather than creating them.
code.writeError.targetNotRegularFile: {path} is not an ordinary file, so espansoConfig will not write over it.
code.writeError.revisionMismatch: {path} had already changed when the save started. Reload it and make the change again.
code.writeError.targetChangedDuringWrite: {path} changed while the save was running, so espansoConfig stopped before replacing it.
code.writeError.tempFileChangedDuringWri: The temporary file this save was writing stopped being the one espansoConfig held, so it was never put in place.
code.writeError.verificationFailed: The file was replaced and then read back as something else. Reload it to see what it holds now.
code.writeError.io: The system refused an operation on {path} while the file was being saved.
code.writeStep.resolveTarget: finding the real file behind the path
code.writeStep.inspectTarget: opening the file and reading what it is
code.writeStep.createTempFile: creating the temporary file beside it
code.writeStep.writeTempFile: writing the new text into the temporary file
code.writeStep.syncTempFile: flushing the temporary file to disk
code.writeStep.copyMetadata: copying the file’s access list and extended attributes
code.writeStep.verifyTempIdentity: checking that the temporary name still points at the file just written
code.writeStep.recheckTarget: checking the file once more just before replacing it
code.writeStep.rename: putting the new file in place of the old one
code.writeStep.syncDirectory: flushing the containing folder to disk
code.writeStep.readBack: reading the file back to check what was stored
code.targetDifference.retargeted: The path now points at {now} instead of the file this save had open.
code.targetDifference.vanished: The file is no longer there.
code.targetDifference.identity: The name now refers to a different file, even though its contents may look the same.
code.targetDifference.contents: The file’s contents changed while the save was running.
code.backupError.io: The system refused an operation on {path} while the copy was being made.
code.backupError.batchNameExhausted: No unused name was left for this session’s backup folder in {path}.
code.backupError.notADirectory: {path} is not a folder, so espansoConfig will not keep backups there.
code.backupError.backupRootNotPrivate: {path} can be reached by someone other than its owner, so espansoConfig will not put copies of your configuration in it.
code.backupError.configRootIsAutoLoaded: {path} is a folder espanso loads snippets from, so no backup may be written under it.
code.backupError.tempFileChangedDuringWr: The temporary name the copy was being written under stopped pointing at it, so the copy was never put in place.
code.backupError.destinationExists: Something already occupies {path}, and this copy was not entitled to choose another name.
code.backupError.backupNameExhausted: No unused name was left for the copy at {path}.
code.backupStep.inspectBackupRoot: reading what the existing backups folder is
code.backupStep.writeBatchMarker: writing the marker that says espansoConfig made this backup folder
code.backupStep.createBackupParents: creating the folders that mirror the file’s own location
code.backupStep.writeBackupFile: writing the file’s current bytes into the copy
code.backupStep.copyExtendedAttributes: copying the file’s extended attributes onto the copy
code.backupStep.applyModeBits: applying the file’s permission bits to the copy
code.backupStep.syncBackupFile: flushing the finished copy to disk
code.backupStep.verifyBackupFile: checking that the copy’s temporary name still points at it
code.backupStep.publishBackupFile: giving the copy its final name
code.rotationOutcome.notAttempted: Older backups were not looked at on this save.
code.rotationOutcome.refused: The folder handed to the tidy-up step is not a backups folder, so nothing was examined.
code.rotationOutcome.scanFailed: The backups folder could not be listed, so older backups were neither counted nor removed.
code.rotationOutcome.scanned: The backups folder was listed and every entry examined.
code.findingClass.editorModelError: Contradicts the shape espansoConfig models for a snippet.
code.findingClass.suspiciousButPermitted: Looks wrong, and espansoConfig cannot prove that it is.
code.findingCode.matchHasNoContentField: This snippet has none of replace, form, markdown, html and image_path, so nothing says what it expands to.
code.findingCode.matchHasSeveralContentF: This snippet has more than one content field, and espansoConfig cannot read off the file which one would win.
code.findingCode.matchHasNoTriggerField: This snippet has none of trigger, triggers and regex, so nothing says when it fires.
code.findingCode.matchHasSeveralTriggerF: This snippet uses more than one of trigger, triggers and regex, and espansoConfig models exactly one.
code.findingCode.variableHasNoType: This variable has no type, so nothing says how to evaluate it.
code.findingCode.variableTypeNotRecognis: espansoConfig does not recognise the variable type “{declared}”. A newer espanso may know it.
code.findingCode.variableMissingRequired: This variable has nothing to evaluate without its “{param}” parameter.
code.findingCode.duplicateVariableName: Two variables of this block are called “{name}”, and espansoConfig cannot tell which definition would be used.
code.findingCode.referenceHasNoDeclarati: The text refers to “{name}”, and nothing this app can see declares a variable of that name.
code.findingCode.regexDoesNotCompile: This regular expression did not compile under the version espansoConfig uses. espanso pins an older one, so the two can disagree.
code.findingCode.documentDoesNotParse: espansoConfig’s YAML parser cannot read this text. It parses with a different library than espanso does, so this is a warning rather than a verdict — but a file espanso cannot read does not load.
code.editError.sourceDoesNotParse: espansoConfig’s YAML parser could not read this file, so nothing in it can be located.
code.editError.unresolvable: The place this change names does not exist in the file.
code.editError.notAScalar: The place this change names is not a single value, so it cannot be given one.
code.editError.emptyTarget: The place this change names holds no bytes of its own, so writing there would put the text on the wrong side of the punctuation that introduces it.
code.editError.refused: This part of the file holds a construct the visual editor cannot rewrite without risking the rest of the file.
code.editError.overlappingEdits: Two changes sent together would rewrite the same bytes, so their order would decide the result.
code.editError.trailingNewlinesNotRepres: The new value’s trailing blank lines cannot be written without changing bytes outside the value.
code.editError.malformedSpan: A byte range did not identify a valid part of the file. That is a fault in this app.
code.editError.notAMapping: The place this change names is not a block of keys, so no entry can be added to it or removed from it.
code.editError.flowCollection: This entry sits inside an inline list or map, which has no line of its own to add or delete.
code.editError.keyAlreadyPresent: The block already has that key, and two entries sharing one key make every path through the block ambiguous.
code.editError.noSuchSibling: The entry this change was to be placed after is not in that block.
code.editError.inconsistentEntryIndentat: The block’s keys do not all start at one column, so a new entry has no indentation to copy.
code.editError.entryDoesNotOwnItsLines: This entry shares its line with something else, and both adding and removing an entry need whole lines.
code.editError.removalWouldExtendAKeptBl: Removing this entry would hand the blank lines below it to a text block above it, changing a value nobody edited.
code.editError.removalWouldDeleteAFileCo: The bytes this removal covers still include a comment that belongs to the file. That is a fault in this app.
code.editError.removalWouldExtendABlockS: The bytes this removal would keep would end up inside a text block above them, changing a value nobody edited.
code.editError.noObservableLineEnding: This file holds no line break for a new entry to copy, and espansoConfig never invents one.
code.editError.lastEntryOfMapping: Removing this would leave the block with no entries, turning it into an empty value and changing what the file means.
code.editError.notASequenceItem: A move relocates an item of a list, and this is not one.
code.editError.noSuchDestinationItem: The list holds no item at the position this move names.
code.editError.moveChangesNothing: This move would leave the item exactly where it already is.
code.editError.moveMustBeTheOnlyEditInIt: A move has to be sent on its own; espansoConfig does not yet check a move combined with another change.
code.editError.moveWouldInventALineEndin: The item’s last line has no line break, so moving it would need one that espansoConfig never invents.
code.editError.moveWouldTerminateTheFina: The file’s last line has no line break, so putting the item there would give that line one.
code.editError.moveWouldExtendAKeptBlock: A text block inside the moved item would meet different bytes where the move puts it, changing a value nobody edited.
code.editError.moveWouldExtendABlockScal: A text block would swallow a line this move puts under it, changing a value nobody edited.
code.editError.notASequence: The place this change names is not a list, so no item can be added to it.
code.editError.insertedItemHasNoFields: A new snippet must hold at least one field; an item with none is an empty value rather than a snippet.
code.editError.duplicateInsertedField: Two of the new item’s fields share a key, and two entries sharing one key make every path through the item ambiguous.
code.editError.invalidInsertedFieldKey: One of the new item’s keys is empty or holds a line break, and neither is a key espansoConfig will write.
code.editError.flowSequenceInsertionUnsu: This list is written inline, between brackets, and rewriting it as an indented list would change the look of bytes nobody asked about.
code.editError.inconsistentSequenceInden: The list’s items do not all start at one column, so a new item has no indentation to copy.
code.editError.implicitNullSequenceHasAm: A comment sits directly under this empty key, so creating a list here would have to decide whether that comment belongs to the list or to what follows it.
code.editError.removalWouldEmptyTheSeque: Removing this would leave the list with no items, and there is no way to write that which still means the same thing.
code.editError.verification: The result was reparsed and checked, it did not pass those checks, and so it was discarded.
code.moveSeam.sourceCloses: where the lines that followed the item rise to sit under the ones that preceded it
code.moveSeam.arrivalLands: where the moved lines come to sit under the destination
code.moveSeam.arrivalCloses: where what followed the destination comes to sit under the moved lines
code.moveSeam.carriedRunsJoin: where two stretches of the moved lines meet, having never been neighbours in the file
code.verificationFailure.doesNotParse: espansoConfig’s YAML parser could not read the result.
code.verificationFailure.targetLost: The edited place cannot be found in the reparsed result.
code.verificationFailure.targetKindChang: The edited place is no longer a single value, so the change altered the file’s structure.
code.verificationFailure.valueMismatch: The reparsed value is not the value that was asked for.
code.verificationFailure.decoderDisagree: espansoConfig and the YAML parser disagree about the value that was just written.
code.verificationFailure.undecodable: The reparsed value could not be decoded at all.
code.verificationFailure.bytesOutsideThe: A byte outside every replaced range is not what it was, and leaving those bytes alone is what this whole app rests on.
code.verificationFailure.spanNotPermitte: A replacement reaches outside the bytes the edited value owns.
code.verificationFailure.lengthMismatch: The result’s length does not match the replacements that produced it.
code.verificationFailure.mappingLost: The block the entry belongs to cannot be found in the reparsed result.
code.verificationFailure.fieldNotInserte: The entry this change was to add is not in the reparsed result.
code.verificationFailure.fieldNotRemoved: The entry this change was to remove is still in the reparsed result.
code.verificationFailure.siblingChanged: A neighbouring entry of the block changed, and nothing asked it to.
code.verificationFailure.entryCountChang: The block holds a different number of entries than the change accounts for.
code.verificationFailure.envelopeCoversA: The bytes marked for removal reach into a node the change does not name.
code.verificationFailure.envelopeMissesT: The bytes marked for removal do not cover the whole entry.
code.verificationFailure.insertionPointI: The place the new entry would go is inside another node.
code.verificationFailure.fileCommentLost: A comment that belongs to the file is not in the result.
code.verificationFailure.itemsNotInTheIn: The list’s items are not in the order the move asked for.
code.verificationFailure.constructChange: Something outside the moved item changed, and nothing asked it to.
code.verificationFailure.documentLinesNo: The result does not hold the same lines the file did.
code.verificationFailure.moveCarriesMore: The move would carry more bytes than the item it names.
code.verificationFailure.movedBytesWereR: The bytes that landed are not the bytes that were lifted.
code.verificationFailure.commentOwnershi: A comment belongs to something different in the result than it did in the file.
code.verificationFailure.ambiguousPlainS: The result holds an unquoted value that YAML 1.1 and YAML 1.2 read differently.
code.verificationFailure.removalCarriesM: The removal would delete more bytes than the entry it names.
code.syntaxError.parse: The YAML parser rejected the document.
code.syntaxError.offset: A reported position fell outside the document. That is a fault in this app.
code.syntaxError.invariant: The reader broke one of its own rules. That is a fault in this app.
code.invariantViolation.invertedSpan: A byte range ends before it starts.
code.invariantViolation.spanOutsideSourc: A byte range leaves the document, or lands inside a character.
code.invariantViolation.blockHeaderNotFo: A text block’s header could not be located, so there is no correct range to publish for it.
code.invariantViolation.frontierOverlap: Two recorded ranges overlap, or are out of order.
code.invariantViolation.unbalancedEvents: The parser closed a block that was never opened, or ended with blocks still open.
code.pathError.noSuchDocument: The file holds no document at the position this address asks for.
code.pathError.emptyDocument: That document has no content, so nothing in it can be addressed.
code.pathError.noSuchKey: No entry of that block is called “{key}”.
code.pathError.duplicateKey: The key “{key}” occurs more than once, so the address names more than one entry.
code.pathError.keyIntoNonMapping: The address asks for a key of something that is not a block of keys.
code.pathError.indexIntoNonSequence: The address asks for a position in something that is not a list.
code.pathError.indexOutOfRange: The list holds fewer items than the address asks for.
code.pathError.noKeySegment: This address is not introduced by a key, so it has no key to report.
code.pathError.malformedIndex: The file’s parsed structure could not be followed. That is a fault in this app.
code.decodeError.spanOutsideSource: The value’s byte range does not identify a valid part of the file, or lands inside a character.
code.decodeError.unknownEscape: A double-quoted value uses an escape sequence YAML does not define.
code.decodeError.malformedNumericEscape: A \x, \u or \U escape is cut short, or is not hexadecimal.
code.decodeError.invalidCodePoint: An escape names a value that is not a character.
code.decodeError.trailingBackslash: A double-quoted value ends with a dangling backslash.
code.notReencodable.foldedStyle: This value is written as a folded text block, so where its line breaks were is not recoverable from the value alone.
code.notReencodable.foldedFlowScalar: This value runs across several lines, and the value alone does not record where the breaks were.
code.notReencodable.nonCanonicalEscaping: This double-quoted value uses escape sequences, and more than one spelling reads back as the same text.
code.notReencodable.nonCanonicalBlankLin: This text block has a line of spaces where YAML reads an empty line, so those spaces are not recoverable from the value.
code.notReencodable.mixedLineBreaks: This text block mixes two kinds of line ending, and one ending cannot reproduce both.
code.notReencodable.bareCarriageReturn: This text block uses a bare carriage return as a line ending, which the value does not record.
code.notReencodable.synthesisedFinalBrea: This text block ends the file with no final line break, so the value carries a break the file does not.
code.notReencodable.undecodable: This value could not be read back at all, so its spelling could not be kept.
code.presentationNote.scalarRestyled: espansoConfig had to write this value in a different style from the one the file used, so its spelling changed as well as its content.
code.presentationNote.doubledSequenceSep: Removing this snippet left the blank lines above it and the blank lines below it next to each other, so the file now has one longer run of blank lines where it had two separate gaps. Neither gap belonged to the snippet, so neither was removed.
code.saveResult.conflict: This file changed after it was read, so nothing was written.
code.saveResult.refused: espansoConfig did not write this file, because of what it found in the result.
code.draftError.matchHasNoPath: espansoConfig could not work out where this snippet sits in the file, so it cannot change anything in it.
code.draftError.matchNotEditable: This snippet holds a construct the visual editor will not rewrite without risking the rest of the file.
code.draftError.ambiguousKey: This snippet writes one of its keys more than once, so no change to it can name a single entry.
code.draftError.notDecodable: espansoConfig could not read the value that is there back as a value, so it cannot tell whether yours differs from it.
code.draftError.notAScalar: What was edited is not a single value in this file, so it cannot be replaced by one.
code.draftError.fieldHasAnUnmodelledShap: This field already holds a list or a block of keys, and the visual editor cannot turn that into a single value.
code.draftError.removalWouldDiscardUnsho: Removing this field would also delete a list or a block of keys that the visual editor never showed you, so nothing was removed.
code.draftError.targetOwnsNoBytes: This entry has no value written after its key, so there is nowhere to put one without moving the punctuation around it.
code.draftError.sequenceItemDoesNotExist: The list has no item at the position this change names.
code.draftError.sequenceItemRemoval: espansoConfig cannot yet take an item out of this list.
code.draftError.sequenceItemDraftedTwice: Two of the changes name the same item of one list, so it is not clear which of them was meant.
code.draftError.noInsertionAnchor: This snippet has no entry a new one could be written after, so nothing can be added to it.
code.draftError.insertionAnchorRemoved: A new entry was to be written after an entry this same save removes. Save the two changes one after the other.
code.draftError.insertionAnchorIsInserte: A new entry was to be written after another entry this same save adds, and only an entry already in the file can serve for that.
code.draftError.insertionAnchorNotInOrig: A new entry was to be written after an entry the file does not have.
code.draftError.sharedInsertionAnchor: Two new entries were to be written in the same place, so their order would decide the file and nothing says what that order is.
code.draftError.removalContainsAnEdit: One change removes an entry that another change edits, so the two cannot be saved together.
code.draftError.scalarEditedTwice: Two changes rewrite the same value.
code.draftError.outsideTheClosedSurface: A change named something outside the part of the snippet the visual editor is allowed to touch. That is a fault in this app.
code.draftError.moveIsNotADraftEdit: A move cannot be saved together with other changes; it has to be sent on its own.
code.draftError.targetDoesNotExist: The variable, parameter, form field or list item this change names is not in the snippet. The visual editor changes what is already there and adds nothing inside a snippet.
code.draftError.variableHasNoPath: espansoConfig could not work out where this variable sits in the file, so it cannot change anything in it.
code.draftError.ambiguousVariableKey: This variable writes one of its keys more than once, so no change to it can name a single entry.
code.draftError.variableFieldHasNoScalar: This variable holds no single value under that key, so there is nothing there to replace.
code.draftError.entryDraftsAScalarAndASe: One entry was given both a single value and a list of values, and it can only have one of the two.
code.draftError.targetIsNotNameable: This entry’s key is not written in a way espansoConfig can address, so nothing under it can be changed.
code.draftError.targetKeyIsAmbiguous: Two entries of that block carry the same key, so a change would rewrite one of them and read as though it had rewritten the other.
code.draftError.nestedValueIsACollection: That entry already holds a list or a block of keys, and the visual editor cannot turn that into a single value.
code.draftError.nestedRemovalWouldDiscar: Removing that entry would also delete a list or a block of keys that the visual editor never showed you, so nothing was removed.
code.draftError.nestedItemRemoval: espansoConfig cannot yet take an item out of that list.
code.draftError.targetDraftedTwice: Two of the changes name one and the same position, so it is not clear which of them was meant.
code.draftError.ambiguousNestedKey: A change names a key its own block writes more than once, so the change would not name a single entry.
